notes.title: Patch notes for update 1.2!
notes.content:
Release version 1.2 is now avaliale.


Bug fixes
1) Fixed a bug where the game scene doesn't do transition.
2) Fixed a bug where pressing "t" does not toggle the hud.

Small graphical changes
1) Improved the texture of all transparent materials.
2) Improved the quality of the baked shader.
3) Further improved terrain's realism.
4) Improved fog behaviour.

notes.title: Patch notes for update 1.1!
notes.content:
Release version 1.1 is now avalible.

Thanks for all reviews and comments! Check out the patch notes of update 1.1 below.

QoL changes
1) Added feature where if you finish the travel log once, the minigame is permanently unlocked for future game sessions for those who want to come back and finish the Aimbot achievement.

2) Added sprint and Physics options in the menu, you can now increase the sprint speed and physics level according to your desire. Physics level only affects how hard you can push objects, with no effect on gravity.

3) [spoilers]Pan-Pan collision is now removed to improve the consistency of the minigame experience. The Aimbot achievement should now be easier to obtain!  [/spoilers]

Bug fixes
1) A rare bug regarding not being able to get off the lift is now fixed. 

New features
1) Added a sound clue for those struggling to find the [spoiler]missing guitar[/spoiler].  [spoiler]A sound is also added when you complete the guitar achievement.[/spoiler]

Improved Graphics
1) Massive Overhaul on the nearby terrain. The Jungfrau summit and surrounding mountain ranges should now look more realistic and natural.
